flaw_1_sonar_cone_clearance_geometry.name: Peripheral Sidewall Rays Falsely Collapsing Front Clearance
flaw_1_sonar_cone_clearance_geometry.symptom: In 0.75m narrow corridors, rays 5 and 9 at +/-34.28 deg hit sidewalls at 0.586m, forcing min(sonar[5:10]) < 1.10m even when direct forward ray 7 was 4.80m
flaw_1_sonar_cone_clearance_geometry.impact: Decoupled longitudinal corridor path from lateral sidewall proximity

flaw_2_dead_end_classification_overreach.name: Narrow Corridor Falsely Classified as Dead-End Enclosure
flaw_2_dead_end_classification_overreach.symptom: Safety veto asserted DEAD_END_ENCLOSURE and forced EMERGENCY_SPIN_LEFT on open narrow corridors
flaw_2_dead_end_classification_overreach.repaired_logic: is_dead_end = (front_direct_clear < 0.75 and front_cone_clear < 0.70 and left_clearance < 1.40 and right_clearance < 1.40)
flaw_2_dead_end_classification_overreach.impact: Eliminated false spin overrides on traversable narrow corridors while preserving true dead-end protection

flaw_3_anticipatory_risk_curve_freeze.name: Premature Collision Risk Slope Causing Forward Freezing
flaw_3_anticipatory_risk_curve_freeze.symptom: Anticipatory risk threshold at 0.95m with 70.0/m slope added 962.0 Free Energy at 0.85m clearance, causing BRAKE_REST to beat forward motion
flaw_3_anticipatory_risk_curve_freeze.repaired_logic: Adjusted risk thresholds to 0.75m (30.0/m) and 0.45m (200.0/m), and updated idling penalty
flaw_3_anticipatory_risk_curve_freeze.impact: Restored forward drive when clearance is 0.75m-0.95m while maintaining steep exponential repulsion below 0.45m
